subject: Renewal + capacity uplift — MSA addendum & order form coordination
messages:
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@acme.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — request for MSA addendum & order form

Hi David,

Thanks again for the Q1 check-in earlier this week. We reviewed usage and want to accelerate the rollout: were planning a ~60% capacity uplift starting July 1 and want to extend the term from 24 to 36 months to lock in pricing.

Procurement asked for two documents to run in parallel: (1) an order form that reflects the new capacity tiers and monthly billing cadence, and (2) an MSA addendum that captures the term extension and updated termination language. Theyre on a tight timeline — target signature by end of April so we can align ops and our finance PO.

Attached is our Q1 usage report for reference (ACME_Usage_Report_Q1.pdf). Can you put together a draft order form + addendum and let us know the expected timeline? Also please flag any legal items we should anticipate (SLA credits, data residency language, indemnity language).

cc: ACME Procurement (procurement@acme.ai)

Thanks,
Claire Nguyen
Head of Platform Partnerships
ACME AI
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Claire Nguyen <claire@acme.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Mar 2024 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — request for MSA addendum & order form

Hi Claire,

Appreciate the context and the usage file — that helps a lot. We can support the uplift and the term extension. Ive attached an initial draft order form (Draft_Orderform_ACME_v2.pdf) and a proposed MSA addendum (Proposed_Addendum_MSA_v2.docx) with the fields filled in based on the 60% uplift and 36-month term.

Proposed next steps (mutual action plan):
- Internal legal review of the addendum redlines (Laura) — 48 hours
- You confirm ramp schedule and any PO constraints (Claire / Procurement) — end of this week
- Ill collate final doc for signature and send DocuSign link — next Monday if all good

Laura / Ben / Monica: can you please review the attached addendum and order form for: (a) termination & remedy language for extended term, (b) SLA credit thresholds for higher capacity, and (c) any billing cadence gotchas when we move to monthly invoicing at new tiers? Ive marked a few line items in the addendum that came up often in prior renewals.

Claire — if procurement has any mandatory clauses (PO number format, net terms), send those over and Ill make sure finance gets it into the order form.

Best,
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Mar 2024 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — legal redlines on MSA addendum

On Mon, Mar 18, 2024 at 11:03 AM David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com> wrote:
> David: can you please review the attached addendum and order form for termination & remedy language...

Team,

I reviewed Proposed_Addendum_MSA_v2.docx and prepared a redline with commentary (MSA_Addendum_Redlines_20240319.docx). High-level notes:

- Term & early termination: we should preserve the ability for either party to terminate for material breach with a 30-day cure period; add a specific carve for non-payment tied to the new monthly cadence.
- SLA credits: add a cap tied to the uplift (example language included). Given the higher committed capacity, were proposing a tiered SLA credit schedule rather than a flat max.
- Indemnity: replace the unlimited indemnity reference with a commercially reasonable cap tied to fees paid in the prior 12 months; ACME may push back here.
- Data residency / audit rights: ACME previously requested stronger audit language; if thats required well need particular controls called out in the order form (region mapping).
- Ramp schedule: legal needs the exact ramp dates and volumes (dates by tier). Without the specific schedule we cannot finalize the capacity-related pricing exhibits.
- Signature block: add countersignatory fields for Redwoods Dedicated Capacity SLA owner (Ben) and ACME Procurement contact.

Timeline: I can turn around a clean final addendum by EOD Thursday provided we get the ramp schedule and confirmation on indemnity cap approach.

Attachments: MSA_Addendum_Redlines_20240319.docx (redline + inline commentary)

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Nguyen <claire@acme.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: ACME Procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 Mar 2024 15:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — MSA addendum & order form coordination

Thanks David and Laura — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detailed notes. We reviewed Lauras redlines internally. A few quick points:

- Indemnity: we can accept a cap tied to 12 months of fees provided theres a carve for IP infringement; please keep the IP carve (non-negotiable for our legal team).
- Ramp schedule: attached PO_12345.pdf includes our intended milestone dates and volumes (match to the tiers in the order form).
- Data residency: we will accept the region mapping approach you suggested, provided we get an audit clause limited to once per 12 months and with a mutually agreed scope.

If Redwood can update the addendum to: (1) include the indemnity cap with IP carve, (2) incorporate the ramp dates from the PO, and (3) add the one-per-year audit scope, we can sign by April 30. Please send the DocuSign link when you have the final files.

Thanks — ccd procurement for visibility.

Claire Nguyen
Head of Platform Partnerships
ACME AI
